Hi Ben / Olivia,

Thanks again for the call today — great alignment on scope and success metrics. Per our agreement I’ve attached a slightly updated Mutual Action Plan (MAP-Acme-RWD-v2.xlsx) that captures the milestones we discussed and owners. High-level items:

- Milestone: Commercial terms signed — Owner: Acme procurement (target: 2026-10-15)
- Milestone: Legal redlines (MSA / DPA / SLA) — Owner: Acme legal to mark redlines; Redwood to produce counter-redlines. Target turnaround: initial redlines by 2026-10-06, Redwood response by 2026-10-09
- Milestone: Security questionnaire & evidence — Owner: Acme (info request point) / Redwood (evidence deliverables) — target: 2026-10-08
- Milestone: Pilot provisioning — Owner: Redwood infra — target: 2026-10-20 (dependent on signed MSA + SOC2 evidence)

A couple of clarifications on the legal milestone:
1) We typically ask customers/legal to provide a single tracked-redline mark-up (MS Word or PDF with comments) that summarizes all requested edits. That makes it much faster for our legal team to review and produce a consolidated counter.
2) Our standard internal SLA for contract turnaround (for deals at this stage) is 3 business days for an initial counter once we get the marked redlines; if there are multiple rounds or complex data-residency asks it can extend.

Can you confirm who from Acme will own the initial redline upload and whether the October 6th target works? I’ve copied Rishi and Neha here to help with timing and to loop in Redwood Legal if we need faster review.

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick sync if that helps.

Best,
